'''Decadence nightclub''' was a nightclub aboard the luxury [[Hovertrain/Legends|repulsortrain]] ''[[Gem of Alderaan]]''.

==Design and layout==
The club was dark inside, with the only light coming from some strobe lights and some dim table lamps. The lower level of the club had a bar, several booths, a dance floor, a main stage and two smaller dance stages that included a floor-to-ceiling [[Bronzium/Legends|bronzium]] pole. On the upper level of the club, there were some small tables and booths, another bar, a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] table and a small manager's suit.

==History==
When the ''Gem of Alderaan'' was launch, [[Alya Aldrete]] had bouncers posted at the entrances to the club. After the train was [[Battle of the Gem of Alderaan|attacked]] by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], some of them attacked the club and fought some [[Alderaanian Resistance]] fighters there.
